thread:
Maya: Quick pulse for the DevEx release window — we want to lock the changelog freeze and start publish steps if owners confirm. Reply with ✅ to confirm or ⚠️ if you need more time. Short blockers only please.

Oli: SDK publish — ✅ I can own. Release branch is `release/v1.4.0` and linux/mac builds are OK. Windows integration job is noisy; two flakes in the last 6 runs. Trying a focused rerun now. Question: include mobile bindings in this ship or punt?

Jordan: Docs deploy — ✅ Build green. I need the final product bullets for the top-level changelog section and the redirect map for the quickstart rename before I hit prod. Can stage the rest and patch the bullets post-deploy if needed.

Lee: Sampleapps smoke — ⚠️ I hit a runtime issue on slack-quickstart (`node` mismatch between CI and local dev). I can submit a tiny PR to pin node in the Dockerfile, but prefer we avoid introducing platform drift. Listing repro in sampleapps CI thread.

Priya: Changelog & release notes — ✅ Template ready. Please confirm any deprecations to mention (old embeddings endpoint) and whether we include the Optimize opt-in blurb.

devex-ci-bot: CI: release/v1.4.0 — linux: success, mac: success, windows: flaky (2/6). https://ci.internal/redwood/rel/140

Maya: Ownership candidates then: SDK = Oli, Docs = Jordan, Sampleapps = Lee, Changelog = Priya. If anyone needs to hand off, call it out in the next 90 minutes. Goal: freeze after +90m.

Oli: Re: mobile bindings — prefer to exclude for this cutoff, ship core SDK first. Will file follow-up ticket to track mobile as a 1.4.x patch. Also retriggered windows job.

Lee: If we must pin node for the sample app, I'll open a minimal PR and mark it `cherry-pick/yes` if it's safe. Otherwise I can try a retry wrapper around `npm start` in the harness to avoid failing the smoke.

Jordan: Draft redirect map I plan to commit if product signs off:
```
/quickstart -> /quickstarts/quickstart-v2
/quickstart/auth -> /quickstarts/quickstart-v2#auth
```
Will push as `docs/redirects.yaml` once approved.

Priya: Product ping: @sam-product we need feature bullets and confirm Optimize blurb text. Prefer inline here so I can finish notes.

sam-product: Sending bullets in ~45m. Optimize blurb approved: "Optimize enables workload-aware batching and recommended quantization presets to lower unit costs while retaining quality." Use exactly.

devex-ci-bot: CI retriggered by Oli — windows job queued.

Oli: Windows job failed on retrigger; attaching short log snippet:
```
Error: session init timeout at tests/integration/session.test.ts:47
```
I'm going to run that test locally with debug flags. If anyone wants to pair, ping.

Lee: I'll try to reproduce the slack-quickstart node issue locally. If it's purely CI, we'll add a retry. If it's the Docker image, I'll submit the minimal Dockerfile pin PR.

Jordan: Product approved the redirect map and dropped bullets into the changelog thread. I'll merge the docs PR after I add the changelog slice.

Priya: Merged changelog slice. ✅ Added deprecation note for old embeddings and Optimize paragraph.

Maya: Final check: owners confirmed? (Oli, Jordan, Lee, Priya)

Oli: ✅

Jordan: ✅

Lee: ✅ — will escalate to infra if sampleapp repro shows CI image bug.

Priya: ✅

Maya: Freeze window engaged. I'll post the release checklist and start the publish steps in ~30m. If anything blocks critically, @mention #devexp-urgent. Thanks all; short and tidy :thumbsup:

Lee: One more FYI — saw a transient 502 from docs-staging but it recovered. Not blocking.

Oli: Follow-up: will open an issue for the session test flake and include logs. If someone wants to help triage, DM me.

Maya: Awesome. Closing this pulse; will update thread after the deploy start.
